_comment: ngsolve plasticity#1 (J2 post-yield slope as the observable). Observed 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604 (E=2e5, nu=0.3, sigma_y=250, H=2000; homogeneous strain on a VectorH1 GridFunction, radial return written in CF algebra, components read out with Integrate): the uniaxial post-yield secant / E equals H/(H+E) to ~1e-13 relative and misses the claim's (1+3mu/H)^-1 by 15%; the SHEAR post-yield secant / mu is the one that equals H/(H+3mu). So the claim's formula is the deviatoric tangent, not the uniaxial one. Skipping the radial return keeps the slope at E and overshoots the yield surface by more than 3x.
